meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: 把流程画成 1920×1080 的白板便利贴图:米黄背景、手写体标题、4 色便利贴节点,节点间用 SVG 曲线连接,可带箭头和虚线分支,并加光标、胶带等装饰。
howto.when: 当你要求把流程、系统或工作流做成白板便利贴风示意图时,通常需要你提供具体流程内容。

say.text: 把用户注册流程画成便利贴白板图
say.note: 会生成 5-12 个便利贴节点

say.text: 用便利贴手写风画这个系统架构
say.note: 需要你先把组件和连线说清楚

say.text: 把这份工作流做成白板流程图
say.note: 节点文字直接用你给的步骤

howto.what_en: Renders a 1920×1080 whiteboard-style sticky-note diagram: beige background, handwritten fonts, 4-color sticky nodes connected by SVG curves, with optional arrows, dashed branches, cursor and tape decorations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a process, system, or workflow into a whiteboard sticky-note illustration; you usually need to provide the actual steps or content.

say_en.text: Draw the user signup flow as a sticky whiteboard diagram
Sketch this system architecture in sticky handwriting style
Turn this workflow into a whiteboard flowchart
say_en.note: Node text comes directly from your steps
